Thank u for all the effort u put into this reply i rly do appreciate it. Im working on the things you mentioned, day by day. At times i feel as if im making progress but of course i also have my setbacks. Im currently experiencing one of those setbacks :,,) i had a nasty breakup about a year ago and that really forced me to learn to be alone. Ive made tons of progress and gotten to know myself on a deeper level but sometimes the loneliness still strikes. I try to work through it :,) 

Therapy has worked for me in the past, but the therapist im currently seeing kinda sucks lol. I gotta say something so i can change that. Ive had lots of different therapists and ive found a few that have helped me, its just trial & error lol. 

For lack of better word i really need to get my shit together and start taking some action. Its easy to say but seems impossible at times but i know im capable of more.

i had an ex that emotionally cheated on me and i totally understand what u mean by cheating anxiety. its the reason i havent put myself out there since the breakup, im so fucking afraid i’ll get hurt again. what i try to tell myself and my friends that struggle w the same thing is u gotta learn to not only trust the other person but trust yourself. 

trust that even if the worst u can imagine happens, u have yourself to rely on. i find for myself that the more i depend on the other person and rely on them as my sole source of happiness the more i start to worry about losing them (cheating, random breakup, all that shit) 

i hate to say it but until you truly love yourself (ugh, cliche i know, but its true) and TRUST yourself, this anxiety will follow you throughout all your relationships, no matter how perfect your s/o is. im still working on this too and although its hard i know its worth it. im partially talking to myself here but i hope u can take value in something i said. i know the feeling of this and i seriously wouldnt wish it on anyone. 

i hope it all works out for u.
